name: ProductGenie AI Shopping Assistant
author: productgenie

sections.description:
ProductGenie adds an AI-powered shopping assistant to your eCommerce store. ProductGenie is built to save customers time and empower them to make smarter buying decisions by addressing a wide range of shopping inquiries and product-related questions.

ProductGenie is a SaaS solution that requires an API key from ProductGenie.io.

Key Features

  • AI-powered shopping assistant that understands customer questions
  • Automatic synchronization of WooCommerce products and reviews
  • Floating widget interface for seamless customer interaction
  • Real-time product information and recommendations

Getting Started

  1. Sign up at ProductGenie.io to get your API key
  2. Install and activate this plugin
  3. Enter your API key in the ProductGenie settings
  4. Click “Sync” to import your products
  5. The AI assistant will automatically appear on your product pages

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to the ProductGenie.io service to provide AI-powered shopping assistance.

External Service: https://productgenie.io/
Privacy Policy: https://productgenie.io/privacy/
Terms of Service: https://productgenie.io/terms/

Data Transmitted:
* Product information (names, descriptions, prices, images, SKUs)
* Product reviews and ratings
* Store URL and name
* Widget configuration settings

No customer personal information or purchase history is transmitted.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/productgenie directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Configure the plugin settings through the ProductGenie menu in your WordPress admin panel under the Woocommerce section.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

This plugin adds an AI-powered shopping assistant to your site. With ProductGenie customers can ask questions about a product directly on the product page.

What data is sent to ProductGenie?

The plugin syncs your WooCommerce product catalog (names, descriptions, prices, images) and customer reviews to ProductGenie servers to power the AI assistant. No customer personal information is shared.

Is this plugin free?

The plugin is free to install, but requires a paid API key from ProductGenie.io to function. Visit https://productgenie.io/ for pricing information.

Where can I find the privacy policy?

You can review our privacy policy at https://productgenie.io/privacy/
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Fixed script enqueueing to use WordPress best practices
  • Moved inline JavaScript to external file (pgai-admin-settings.js)
  • Used wp_enqueue_script() and wp_localize_script() for proper script loading
  • Improved admin page performance and security

1.0.3

  • Major refactoring for WordPress.org compliance
  • Renamed plugin to “ProductGenie AI Shopping Assistant”
  • Updated plugin slug to productgenie-ai-shopping-assistant
  • Changed all function prefixes from product_genie_ to pgai_
  • Updated REST API namespace to productgenie-ai/v1
  • Updated contributor to official productgenie account
  • Improved namespace collision prevention

1.0.2

  • Added widget display settings to control visibility per page type
  • Added option to toggle WooCommerce review syncing
  • Implemented instant-save settings with AJAX feedback
  • Added master enable/disable toggle for the widget
  • Improved settings UI with organized sections (Step 1, 2, 3)

1.0.1

  • Improved WordPress.org compliance
  • Added privacy policy and data handling documentation
  • Fixed text domain for better compatibility
  • Added WooCommerce dependency declaration
  • Cleaned up codebase for submission

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • AI-powered shopping assistant
  • WooCommerce product and review synchronization
  • Floating widget interface
  • Real-time product recommendations
